name: Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems
issuing_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Defines security categories (Low, Moderate, High) based on confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact levels. Mandatory federal standard: FIPS publications are issued by NIST, approved by the Secretary of Commerce under 40 U.S.C. § 11331 (originally ITMRA § 5131, P.L. 104-106), and binding on federal agencies. This distinguishes FIPS from NIST Special Publications (SP), which are sometimes mandatory and sometimes guidelines depending on individual statutory backing.

derives_from.note: FISMA directs NIST to develop security standards including categorization.
Authorizes NIST to promulgate compulsory federal information security standards.
